watch.summary: The creator passionately hypes up pro Valorant player Cryo as he executes an impressive 4K multi-kill play.

beats.what: Creator watches 100T Cryo playing Chamber in an esports match.
Cryo gets a kill and the creator starts screaming in excitement.
Cryo secures the round win with multiple kills and the creator shouts loudly.
The creator throws his arms out shouting that they are awake now.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: Get him out of my face, bro!
watch.why: This clip relies entirely on high-energy esports hype and skill hype rather than comedic storytelling or punchlines. It delivers excitement for Valorant fans, but little comedy for an outside viewer.
